name: MetaCAMPUS Authentication Contract
description: Authentication and role management contract for MetaCAMPUS platform

local.name: university_name
local.description: Associated university name (for students and university admins)

local.name: is_active
local.description: Whether the user account is active (1) or suspended (0)

methods.name: register_user
methods.description: Register a new user with a role

args.name: user_address
args.description: Algorand address of the user to register

args.name: university_name
args.description: University name (required for students and university admins)

methods.name: get_user_role
methods.description: Get the role of a user

methods.name: update_user_status
methods.description: Activate or suspend a user account

methods.name: verify_auth
methods.description: Verify if a user has a specific role

returns.description: 1 if user has required role and is active, 0 otherwise

student.description: Student role - can view transcripts and request badges

university_admin.description: University Admin role - can manage students and approve badges

super_admin.description: Super Admin role - can manage universities and system settings

usage.initialization: Deploy contract with super admin wallet address as creator
usage.registration: Super admin or university admin calls register_user to add new users
usage.verification: Any user can call verify_auth to check permissions
usage.management: Super admin can update user status to activate/suspend accounts

notes: Contract must be deployed by the designated super admin wallet
Super admin wallet address is stored in global state during deployment
All role assignments are permanent unless super admin updates them
Contract version 2.0 uses Pera Wallet for authentication
